sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "global_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'guest', "kind" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("kind" BETWEEN 0 AND 1), "created_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_day" TEXT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("id", "kind"), UNIQUE ("id", "owner"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_titles" ("goal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES goals (id), "effective_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("title") > 0), PRIMARY KEY ("goal_id", "effective_day"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_schedules" ("goal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES goals (id), "effective_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekdays" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("weekdays" BETWEEN 0 AND 127), "planned_day" TEXT NULL, "start_minute" INTEGER NULL CHECK("start_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "duration_minutes" INTEGER NULL CHECK("duration_minutes" BETWEEN 5 AND 480 AND ("start_minute" IS NULL OR "start_minute" + "duration_minutes" <= 1440)), PRIMARY KEY ("goal_id", "effective_day"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "check_ins" ("goal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES goals (id), "goal_kind" INTEGER NOT NULL, "occurrence_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "completed_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "title_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "planned_day" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("goal_id", "occurrence_key"), FOREIGN KEY (goal_id, goal_kind) REFERENCES goals (id, kind), CHECK ((goal_kind = 1 AND occurrence_key = 'once') OR (goal_kind = 0 AND occurrence_key = completed_day)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_reminders" ("goal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES goals (id), "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "minute_of_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1200 CHECK("minute_of_day" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "needs_reconcile" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("needs_reconcile" IN (0, 1)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'disabled', PRIMARY KEY ("goal_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminder_occurrences" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "goal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES goals (id), "owner" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'guest', "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "fire_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "armed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("armed" IN (0, 1)), "ended" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("ended" IN (0, 1)), UNIQUE ("goal_id", "day"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_states" ("goal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES goals (id), "server_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "local_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "confirmed_json" TEXT NULL, "last_synced_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("goal_id"), CHECK (server_revision >= 0 AND local_revision >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES goals (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "document_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "base_revision" INTEGER NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "retry_after" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "superseded_by" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("operation_id"), UNIQUE ("operation_id", "goal_id", "owner"), FOREIGN KEY (goal_id, owner) REFERENCES goals (id, owner) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CHECK (local_revision > 0 AND attempts >= 0), CHECK (base_revision IS NULL OR base_revision >= 0), CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'in_flight', 'conflict', 'superseded')), CHECK (state != 'in_flight' OR base_revision IS NOT NULL), CHECK (kind IN ('create', 'edit', 'set_completed', 'set_uncompleted', 'archive', 'import_guest', 'resolve_conflict')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_conflicts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES goals (id), "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sync_outbox (operation_id), "base_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remote_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "resolved_at" INTEGER NULL, "resolution" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("operation_id"), FOREIGN KEY (goal_id, owner) REFERENCES goals (id, owner) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CHECK (base_revision >= 0 AND remote_revision >= 0), FOREIGN KEY (operation_id, goal_id, owner) REFERENCES sync_outbox (operation_id, goal_id, owner), CHECK (resolution IS NULL OR resolution IN ('local', 'remote')), CHECK ((resolved_at IS NULL) = (resolution IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "identity_states" ("singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'guest', "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "target_owner" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("singleton"), CHECK (singleton = 1 AND generation >= 0));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "guest_transfers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_ids_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "planning_profiles" ("owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "preferences" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "planning_drafts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "budget" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tasks_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "applied_goal_ids_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assistant_settings" ("owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "consent_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "consented_at" INTEGER NULL, "send_memories" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("send_memories" IN (0, 1)), "send_schedule" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("send_schedule" IN (0, 1)), "send_stats" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("send_stats" IN (0, 1)), "auto_memory" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("auto_memory" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("owner"), CHECK ((consent_version = 0 AND consented_at IS NULL) OR (consent_version > 0 AND consented_at IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assistant_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "summary" TEXT NULL, "summary_through" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("id", "owner"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assistant_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "request_id" TEXT NULL, "sent_payload" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("id", "owner"), UNIQUE ("id", "session_id", "owner"), FOREIGN KEY (session_id, owner) REFERENCES assistant_sessions (id, owner) ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK (role IN ('user', 'assistant')), CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'sent', 'failed', 'discarded')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assistant_memories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_session_id" TEXT NULL, "source_message_id" TEXT NULL, "source_label" TEXT NULL, "expires_on" TEXT NULL, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (category IN ('作息', '偏好', '目标与背景', '近期约束', '其他')), CHECK (length(content) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memory_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "memory_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "before_json" TEXT NULL, "after_json" TEXT NULL, "reverted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reverted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), FOREIGN KEY (message_id, owner) REFERENCES assistant_messages (id, owner) ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK (op IN ('add', 'update', 'delete')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_proposals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL, "message_id" TEXT NULL, "items_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', "applied_items_json" TEXT NULL, "applied_goal_ids_json" TEXT NULL, "applied_at" INTEGER NULL, "undone_at" INTEGER NULL, "undo_result_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), FOREIGN KEY (session_id, owner) REFERENCES assistant_sessions (id, owner), FOREIGN KEY (message_id, session_id, owner) REFERENCES assistant_messages (id, session_id, owner), CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'applied', 'undone')), CHECK (status != 'draft' OR (session_id IS NOT NULL AND message_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (status = 'draft' OR (applied_items_json IS NOT NULL AND applied_goal_ids_json IS NOT NULL AND applied_at IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (status != 'undone' OR (undone_at IS NOT NULL AND undo_result_json IS NOT NULL)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminder_cancellations" ("notification_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("notification_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "zone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UTC', "content" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "share_with_partner" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("share_with_partner" IN (0, 1)), "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "saved_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_operation_id" TEXT NULL, "draft_text" TEXT NULL, "draft_share_with_partner" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("draft_share_with_partner" IN (0, 1)), "draft_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("goal_id", "owner", "day"), UNIQUE ("id", "owner"), FOREIGN KEY (goal_id, owner) REFERENCES goals (id, owner), CHECK (revision >= 0 AND draft_revision >= 0), CHECK (sync_state IN ('local', 'pending', 'confirmed', 'failed')), CHECK (last_operation_id IS NULL OR length(last_operation_id) = 36));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "record_photos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "filename" TEXT NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height" INTEGER NOT NULL, "byte_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "upload_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "saved_position" INTEGER NULL, "draft_position" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("owner", "filename"), UNIQUE ("record_id", "saved_position"), UNIQUE ("record_id", "draft_position"), FOREIGN KEY (record_id, owner) REFERENCES day_records (id, owner), CHECK (width BETWEEN 1 AND 1600 AND height BETWEEN 1 AND 1600), CHECK (byte_count BETWEEN 1 AND 2097152), CHECK (filename = id || '.jpg' AND id NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9-]*'), CHECK (sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*'), CHECK (saved_position IS NULL OR saved_position BETWEEN 0 AND 2), CHECK (draft_position IS NULL OR draft_position BETWEEN 0 AND 2), CHECK (upload_state IN ('local', 'pending', 'uploaded', 'failed')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_analysis_settings" ("owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "consent_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "consented_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner"), CHECK (consent_version >= 0), CHECK ((consent_version = 0) = (consented_at IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_analyses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "request_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "response_json" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "failure_code" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled')), CHECK ((status = 'succeeded') = (response_json IS NOT NULL)), CHECK ((status IN ('failed', 'cancelled')) = (failure_code IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pairing_states" ("owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "credential_scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "state_json" TEXT NULL, "state_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "refreshed_at" INTEGER NULL, "draft_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "draft_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("owner"), CHECK (generation >= 0 AND state_revision >= 0 AND draft_revision >= 0), CHECK ((state_json IS NULL) = (refreshed_at IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pairing_commands" ("owner" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pairing_states (owner), "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "request_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, "retry_after" INTEGER NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "base_state_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "base_draft_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner"), CHECK (kind IN ('createInvite','cancelInvite','join','leave')), CHECK (status IN ('sending','uncertain','failed')), CHECK ((status = 'sending') = (error_code IS NULL)), CHECK (generation >= 0 AND attempts > 0 AND base_state_revision >= 0 AND base_draft_revision >= 0), CHECK (retry_after IS NULL OR retry_after >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sharing_states" ("owner" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pairing_states (owner), "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "member_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "partner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cache_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_revision" INTEGER NULL, "refreshed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner"), CHECK (generation >= 0 AND cache_revision >= 0), CHECK (server_revision IS NULL OR server_revision >= 0), CHECK ((server_revision IS NULL) = (refreshed_at IS NULL)), CHECK (member_id <> partner_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sharing_grants_cache" ("owner" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sharing_states (owner), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "document_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner", "id"), UNIQUE ("owner", "goal_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shared_records_cache" ("owner" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sharing_states (owner), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "grant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "author_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "document_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner", "id"), UNIQUE ("owner", "sequence"), CHECK (sequence > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shared_replies_cache" ("owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "author_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "document_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner", "id"), UNIQUE ("owner", "sequence"), FOREIGN KEY (owner, record_id) REFERENCES shared_records_cache(owner, id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK (sequence > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sharing_drafts" ("owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner", "record_id"), FOREIGN KEY (owner, record_id) REFERENCES shared_records_cache(owner, id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK (revision >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sharing_commands" ("sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sharing_states (owner), "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NULL, "request_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "draft_revision" INTEGER NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, "receipt_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK (kind IN ('enable','stop','publish','remove','reply','deleteReply')), CHECK (status IN ('pending','sending','uncertain','failed','succeeded')), CHECK ((status IN ('failed','uncertain')) = (error_code IS NOT NULL)), CHECK ((status = 'succeeded') = (receipt_json IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (attempts >= 0 AND (draft_revision IS NULL OR draft_revision >= 0)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "record_sharing_consents" ("owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "stage" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "grant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner", "record_id", "stage"), FOREIGN KEY (record_id, owner) REFERENCES day_records(id, owner), FOREIGN KEY (owner, grant_id) REFERENCES sharing_grants_cache(owner, id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK (stage IN ('created','draft','saved')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sharing_publication_sources" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "grant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_id" TEXT NULL, "remote_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("owner", "id"), UNIQUE ("owner", "grant_id", "goal_id", "day"), FOREIGN KEY (goal_id, owner) REFERENCES goals(id, owner), FOREIGN KEY (owner, grant_id) REFERENCES sharing_grants_cache(owner, id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK (remote_revision >= 0), CHECK ((remote_id IS NULL) = (remote_revision = 0)), CHECK (remote_id IS NULL OR length(remote_id) = 36));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sharing_publications" ("sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NULL, "record_revision" INTEGER NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "share_details" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("share_details" IN (0, 1)), "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "request_json" TEXT NULL, "receipt_json" TEXT NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("owner", "operation_id"), FOREIGN KEY (owner, source_id) REFERENCES sharing_publication_sources(owner, id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (record_id, owner) REFERENCES day_records(id, owner), CHECK (kind IN ('publish','remove')), CHECK (status IN ('pending','sending','uncertain','failed','succeeded')), CHECK ((status IN ('failed','uncertain')) = (error_code IS NOT NULL)), CHECK ((status = 'succeeded') = (receipt_json IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (share_details OR content = ''), CHECK (attempts >= 0 AND (record_revision IS NULL OR record_revision >= 0)), CHECK ((record_id IS NULL) = (record_revision IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sharing_publication_photos" ("owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "photo_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES record_photos (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "upload_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "receipt_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner", "operation_id", "photo_id"), UNIQUE ("owner", "operation_id", "position"), FOREIGN KEY (owner, operation_id) REFERENCES sharing_publications(owner, operation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK (position BETWEEN 0 AND 2));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_states" ("owner" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sharing_states (owner), "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cache_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_revision" INTEGER NULL, "snapshot_revision" INTEGER NULL, "refreshed_at" INTEGER NULL, "read_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "draft_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "draft_photo_id" TEXT NULL, "draft_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("owner"), CHECK (cache_revision >= 0 AND read_sequence >= 0 AND draft_revision >= 0), CHECK (server_revision IS NULL OR server_revision >= 0), CHECK (snapshot_revision IS NULL OR (snapshot_revision >= 0 AND snapshot_revision <= server_revision)), CHECK (refreshed_at IS NULL OR server_revision IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_messages_cache" ("owner" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_states (owner), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "author_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "document_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner", "id"), UNIQUE ("owner", "sequence"), CHECK (sequence > 0));
